description: Build a compact macro briefing for a currency by combining catalogue, key macro series, release-calendar, prediction, news, risk-sentiment, COT, seasonality, and FX technical context. Returns analysis in the tool response. Access: USD is available without an API key; every other currency returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code (case-insensitive). Supported: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy.
